evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive performed as a settled instruction the speaker expects to be carried out — ratification-grade command, not an argued position.

observations.why: Performed imperative commanding erasure of knowledge — settled, load-bearing, expects compliance; same conviction pattern as src-1.
